subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR for this cron stagger bug, ask the fork author to reopen it against the target repo with maintainer edits enabled, or close that path and queue a fresh repair?
rationale: The issue is valid and narrow, but an open closing PR already exists outside the target repository and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork PR
options.body: Preserve the useful patch and credit while landing a target-repo PR that maintainers can review, update, and merge.

options.title: Ask the author to reopen in target repo
options.body: Wait for the contributor to provide an editable OpenClaw PR with real validation before further repair work.

options.title: Close the fork path and queue repair
options.body: Explicitly close or decline the fork PR, then allow ClawSweeper to make a fresh narrow fix PR for this issue.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Preserve the useful patch and credit while landing a target-repo PR that maintainers can review, update, and merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the default cron stagger helper and service integration, making them the strongest history-based owner for the adoption/replacement choice.
